rationale: The generated `final(ret.unwrap())@` partition clause overstates what a function returning a mutable slice can guarantee: the returned mutable region may be modified independently, so its final element values are not constrained to remain an old-source prefix or suffix. Removing that single final-return partition preserves the None frame and initial returned-region partition established by the executable Rust body; this correction is now mirrored into the active Slice/Vec proof and catalog artifacts.
